answer: A per-epoch sybil tax blocks fake identities by charging each one to stay alive. Each epoch, an identity pays 30 credits, burned not staked; unpaid identities lose attestation rights. The levy sends a ripple through a farm each epoch, so unpaid copies cannot hide behind one paid front. The k-th fake still costs 30 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 30,000 per epoch, linear with headcount. Levy lending fails: each receipt binds to one key and cannot be replayed, like timber in one house cannot frame a second. In an ocean of agents, one honest identity pays only 30 credits.
